messages.content: Do you think people are more honest with strangers or with people who know them well?
Honestly, often strangers, actually - there's less at stake with someone who won't carry the information into your daily life, which paradoxically makes honesty easier.
That's kind of sad in a way.
Fair, honestly - though it also shows why building real trust with close people matters so much, since that ease with strangers is artificial safety, not real intimacy.
